knowledge:
- key_parameters: PopSize=Size of the population (default = 100) ;; MinSize=Minimum number of nodes allowed in each subnetwork (default = 15) ;; MaxSize=Maximum number of nodes allowed in each subnetwork (default = 50) ;; Generations=Total number of generations of the evolution process (default = 500) ;; TournamentSize=Number of individuals participating in the parent selection tournament (default = 2) ;; CrossoverRate=Crossover rate in the [0-1] range (default = 0.8) ;; MutationRate=Mutation rate in the [0-1] range (default = 0.1) ;; JaccardSimilarityThreshold=Maximum Jaccard similarity coefficient to consider two subnetworks as different during initialization (default = 30) or minimum coefficient to merge subnetworks during post-processing (default = 70) ;; MaxNumberOfAttempts=Maximum attempts allowed to find compatible parents for crossover (default = 3) ;; Measure=Statistical value to use, either "FDR" or "PValue" (default = FDR) ;; ThresholdDEG=Maximum value of Measure to consider a gene as significantly differentially expressed (default = 0.05) ;; Layers=String of characters determining which network files from NetworkLayersDir are used to build the multiplex network (e.g., "23") ;; Cores=Number of processor cores to use for parallel runs (default = 1) ;; NumberOfRunsToExecute=Number of runs to perform (default = 1, recommended = 30) ;; VisualizeInCytoscape=Boolean determining whether to display the accumulated Pareto front in Cytoscape (default = TRUE)
- alternatives: None mentioned.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have transcriptomics differential expression results (FDR or p-values) and one or more biological networks (multiplex network layers), and you want to identify active, highly connected, and deregulated subnetworks.
- pitfalls: There was a bug in the non-domination sorting process; all runs executed between October 15th, 2020 and February 12th, 2021 must be re-executed. Running the algorithm for the recommended 500 generations can be computationally expensive (taking up to 12 hours for a 3-layer multiplex network). Parallel execution (Cores > 1) is NOT supported on Windows. The differential expression input file must contain at least "gene" and the selected Measure ("FDR" or "PValue") columns. Each network layer file must be in a 2-column tab-separated format, and each file name must start with a unique character. Cytoscape must be running on the computer if VisualizeInCytoscape is set to TRUE.

workflows.name: active_module_identification
workflows.intent: Identify active modules in a multiplex biological network using differential expression data and multi-objective genetic optimization.
input: Sample_DE.csv (comma-separated file containing gene names, FDR/PValue, and optionally logFC)
Sample_NodesScore.csv (optional comma-separated file containing pre-calculated node scores)
NetworkLayersDir (directory containing 2-column tab-separated network files, each starting with a unique character)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize evolution and general parameters using mogamun_init ;; 2. Load differential expression data and multiplex network layers using mogamun_load_data ;; 3. Run the genetic algorithm using mogamun_run ;; 4. Post-process the results and optionally visualize in Cytoscape using mogamun_postprocess
workflows.code:
parameters <- mogamun_init(Generations = 1, PopSize = 10)

dePath <- system.file("extdata/DE/Sample_DE.csv", package = "MOGAMUN")
scoresPath <-
    system.file("extdata/DE/Sample_NodesScore.csv", package = "MOGAMUN")
layersPath <-
    paste0(system.file("extdata/LayersMultiplex", package = "MOGAMUN"), "/")

loadedData <-
    mogamun_load_data(
        EvolutionParameters = parameters,
        DifferentialExpressionPath = dePath,
        NodesScoresPath = scoresPath,
        NetworkLayersDir = layersPath,
        Layers = "23"
    )

mogamun_run(LoadedData = loadedData, ResultsDir = '.')

mogamun_postprocess(
    LoadedData = loadedData, 
    ExperimentDir = '.', 
    VisualizeInCytoscape = FALSE
)
